definitions.explanation: The continent of South America, comprising twelve independent countries and several territories. In Japanese, commonly referred to in both full and abbreviated forms.

examples.japanese: {南|みなみ}アメリカに{行|い}きたい。
examples.english: I want to go to South America.

examples.japanese: {南|みなみ}アメリカには{熱帯|ねったい}の{森|もり}が{広|ひろ}がっている。
examples.english: Tropical forests spread across South America.

examples.japanese: {南|みなみ}アメリカ{大陸|たいりく}には{世界|せかい}で{最|もっと}も{長|なが}い{山脈|さんみゃく}がある。
examples.english: The South American continent has the longest mountain range in the world.

notes:
Written either as {南|みなみ}アメリカ or {南米|なんべい}. The full form is used in everyday conversation, while {南米|なんべい} is the Sino-Japanese abbreviation preferred in news reports, formal writing, and compound terms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {南|みなみ}アメリカ{大陸|たいりく}: the South American continent
- {南|みなみ}アメリカ{諸国|しょこく}: South American countries
- {南|みなみ}アメリカ{旅行|りょこう}: travel to South America

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {南米|なんべい}: South America — Sino-Japanese abbreviation; more compact and formal
- {北|きた}アメリカ: North America — the northern counterpart
- {中南米|ちゅうなんべい}: Central and South America — often grouped together in Japanese media
